questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code sets expiry on cached preferences? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A user has never saved preferences. They receive several notifications over a few minutes. How many repository lookups happen, assuming the cache is available and the absent TTL has not elapsed?
choices: One per notification, because absent users are never cached
One for the first notification only, later ones see the Absent marker and use the defaults
None, because the cache is pre-filled with defaults
Two: one to find the user and one to confirm the default

questions.prompt: A user turns off every channel and saves an empty set. How does channelsFor behave for that user afterwards?
choices: It returns the default email channel because an empty set looks absent
It returns an empty set from the repository or cache, since an empty encoding is distinguished from the absent marker
It throws IllegalArgumentException when decoding the empty string
It returns an empty set only on the first call; later calls return defaults

questions.prompt: A user who has no stored preferences saves them right after being cached as absent. When do notifications start honoring the new preferences?
choices: Only after the absent TTL elapses
Immediately, since update() saves and then evicts the cached marker
Only when channelsFor is called twice
